title: Stolen Singing Swords
description: Stolen Singing Swords — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Hughard the Arms Merchant

Quest Type: Collect

Quest Description: collect 27 Stolen Singing Swords from monsters in Vegrim's Vexation

Quest Reward: 2,750 Gold and 1 Kings Coins

Return to: Hughard the Arms Merchant

Repeatable: Yes

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: Collect 14 Antique Singing Swords and Return them to Hughard the Arms Merchant in Townston.

Offer:

Ah, am I glad to see you again! You are still in the business of running dungeons, right? Good! I had a shipment of old antique magic singing swords on their way here but they have been hijacked in Vergrim's Vexation. Can you believe that?! A whole shipment of antique magical singing swords!

Would you be willing to go into Vergrim's Vexation and retrieve some of the stolen shipment for me? There were so many antique singing swords that I'm sure almost every creature has one, so it should not be a problem for you to recover them. Once you get them return to me, Hughard the Arms Merchant, here in Townston and I will reward you for your efforts.

Turn-in:

You have found them? Oh, that is some most excellent news. These swords are going to fetch me a pretty penny, thanks to you! Here is your reward lad, you have earned it!

Objectives:

  • Antique Singing Swords ×14

Client level range: 22–30
